meta.source: M4CROPHAGE Season One Audit Through S1-M028

news.title: Mbappé takes both major scoring crowns
news.body: Kylian Mbappé leads M4CROPHAGE with 11 goals and 7 GVA through S1-M028.

news.title: Messi remains the creative engine
news.body: Lionel Messi leads the club with 13 verified assists.

news.title: Lamine scores on debut night
news.body: Lamine Yamal scored in the 2-1 victory over Maxcovac102 in S1-M024.

news.title: Dimarco restores the armband
news.body: Federico Dimarco captained the two most recent scoreless draws.

news.title: Three straight matches without a goal
news.body: M4CROPHAGE has drawn two scoreless matches after the 0-2 defeat in S1-M026.

news.title: 3-4-3 Flat opens with a clean sheet
news.body: The first trial produced a 0-0 draw despite four shots on target.

news.title: Van der Sar reaches seven clean sheets
news.body: The goalkeeper has 66 credited saves from 111 shots on target faced.
